Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  You can't activate multiple effects that play or use a card at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: 2 copies of this card are in the battle area.  Can I activate the [Main] effect on both copies of this card and play or use 1 of the specified cards with the cost reduced by the total value?

Card Q&A.a:
You can activate the effect and play such a card, but its play cost won't be reduced.
